intent: Initial balanced geometry with 5 medium-sized sensors evenly spaced at the front, moderate body size and mass, and mid-range wheel radius and track. This aims to provide good line detection and stable handling to enable the integrator to build a controller and gather baseline race data.
rationale: Since this is the first iteration, we have no integration feedback or race telemetry yet. To start, I propose a balanced geometry with moderate body size and mass, a mid-sized sensor array with 5 sensors evenly spaced across the front, and medium sensor size. This configuration aims to provide good line detection coverage and stable handling without excessive mass or size that could hinder maneuverability. The wheel radius and track are set to mid-range values to balance speed and stability. The intent is to establish a baseline geometry that is neither extreme nor minimal, allowing the integrator to build a controller and gather initial race data. The hypotheses are that this geometry will enable the robot to follow the line reliably and complete a significant portion of the track. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to evaluate line following performance and identify any issues with sensor coverage or robot stability.
